text: Customer agrees to waive all rights to legal action against Company for any damages whatsoever, including damages resulting from Company's gross negligence or willful misconduct.
All data, materials, and content uploaded or submitted by Customer become the permanent, exclusive, and irrevocable property of Company with perpetual rights to sell or monetize.
This subscription shall automatically renew annually at Company's then-current rates with unlimited price increases, and Customer forfeits any right to refund or mid-term cancellation.
Company reserves the sole right to alter, modify, or terminate any terms of this agreement at any time without prior notice, effective immediately upon posting.
For a period of 5 years following termination, Receiving Party shall not engage in, consult for, or invest in any competing business entity worldwide.
Any dispute arising under this agreement shall be settled solely through confidential, individual binding arbitration, and Customer waives all rights to join class action lawsuits.
Late payments beyond 30 days shall accrue interest at a rate of 1.5% per month (18% annually) or the maximum legal rate, plus collection costs.
Customer grants Company a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use Customer's trade name, logo, and public feedback in marketing materials and public case studies.
This agreement shall be governed exclusively by the laws of the Cayman Islands, and all proceedings must take place exclusively in Grand Cayman courts.
Termination for convenience requires at least 90 days prior written notice sent via registered mail to Company headquarters.
Either party may terminate this agreement without cause upon providing thirty (30) days prior written notice to the other party.
Invoices are issued monthly and shall be paid in full within thirty (30) days of receipt.
Confidential Information shall not include information that is or becomes publicly known through no breach of this agreement by the receiving party.
Neither party shall be liable for failure to perform its obligations if such failure results from acts of God, flood, earthquake, or other natural disasters.
This agreement constitutes the entire understanding between the parties and supersedes all prior oral or written agreements or understandings.
